LanguageData.FB_ManualTentacle_Desc:
Control a hauling tendril.

Hauling: point at an item, corpse, or downed pawn, including enemies. An eligible target lights up. Click to pick it up; the tendril grows from nearby flesh and follows your cursor within flesh territory. Click again to place the load. Forbidden items are automatically unforbidden. Hauling costs no hemogel.

Placing pawns: use a suitable bed, casket, or other container. A prisoner bed takes an outsider prisoner; capturing a non-hostile pawn angers their faction. Ordinary beds do not accept enemies, and rescued outsiders become guests.

Repair: with an empty tendril, click a damaged organoid, then hold the left mouse button over it. Each restored hit point consumes network hemogel.

Right-click to leave this mode.
